```{r}
sample_metadata_filepath <- "/root/capsule/data/tak188-mouse-preclinical-nanostring-v2/"
results_filepath <- "/root/capsule/data/tak188-mouse-preclinical-nanostring-results/"
```

# Read in data

```{r}
sample_info <- read.csv(file.path(sample_metadata_filepath, "20260408_metadata.csv"))
# Add a 'replicate' column to sample_info
sample_info %<>%
   group_by(treatment, day) %>%
   mutate(replicate = row_number()) %>%
   ungroup()
sample_info %<>%
    mutate(sample_id_clean = janitor::make_clean_names(file_name))

# Read in from Results object
load(file = file.path(results_filepath, "nanostring_results.RData"))
```

```{r eval=F}
# List all files with .RCC extension in the specified directory
rcc_files <- list.files(rcc_filepath, 
                  pattern = "\\.RCC$", 
                  full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
load(file.path(panel_info_filepath, "mouse_io360_panel_info.RData"))
```

# Preprocessing and Normalization

## Selection of HKGs

7/20 of the HKG on the panel are omitted for normalization purposes
due to lower than 100 mean expression (pre-normalization) 
or expression below negative control background in > 80% of samples.

```{r eval=F}
use_hkg_names <- c("NM_009089.2", "NM_001159605.1", "NM_023281.1", "NM_013854.1", "NM_011638.4", 
"NM_013684.3", "NM_010368.1", "NM_028076.2", "NM_008062.2", "NM_008753.4", "NM_027886.3", 
"NM_011874.2", "NM_144522.5")
```

## Sample removal

Day 14, Sample 06 was removed due to QC Fail.

D10 Sample 05 and D14 Sample 09 were removed as PCA outliers.

Samples at D10 with higher expression of all genes (1, 2, 12) and 
at D14 with lower expression of all genes (2, 7) were left in 
as normalization seems to be able to take care of it.

```{r eval=F}
rcc_d10 <- rcc_files[grepl("day 10", rcc_files)]
rcc_d10 <- rcc_d10[c(1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11,12)]

rcc_d14 <- rcc_files[grepl("day 14", rcc_files)]
rcc_d14 <- rcc_d14[c(1,2,3,4,5,7,8,10,11)]
```

## RUVg normalization 

Few features remaining using bgPVal and t-test; so didn't remove background.

### Can we do both days together? Doesn't look like it.

```{r eval=F}
# 1 component - high variability
# 2 components - D14 looks even, D10 definitely not
# More than 2 - no change from 2
datRUVg_bothdays <- processNanostringData(nsFiles = c(rcc_d10, rcc_d14),
                             normalization = "RUVg",
                             bgType = "none", 
                             n.unwanted = 2, 
                             RUVg.drop = 0,
                             housekeeping = use_hkg_names,
                             output.format = "list")
```

```{r eval=F}
ruv::ruv_rle(t(log2(datRUVg_bothdays$exprs)), ylim = c(-2, 2))
p <- nanostringPCA(datRUVg_bothdays, interactive.plot = TRUE)
p$plt
```

```{r eval=F}
# Days separate.
data.frame(p$pca$x) %>%
   rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
   mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = "20260408_day ", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
   mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = ".RCC", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
   mutate(day = ifelse(grepl("10", sample), "D10", "D14")) %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
   geom_point(size = 3, aes(color = day)) +
   theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
   ggtitle("Both days")
```

### D10 - 2 components

RLE plot shows that Sample 12 distribution has a higher mean, especially with only 1 unwanted component (default).
I upped it to 2 which improves it a bit.

PC1 (30% of variance), PC2 (15% of variance).

```{r eval=F}
datRUVg_d10 <- processNanostringData(nsFiles = rcc_d10,
                             normalization = "RUVg",
                             bgType = "none", 
                             n.unwanted = 2, 
                             RUVg.drop = 0,
                             housekeeping = use_hkg_names,
                             output.format = "list")
```

```{r}
ruv::ruv_rle(t(log2(datRUVg_d10$exprs)), ylim = c(-2, 2))
p <- nanostringPCA(datRUVg_d10, interactive.plot = TRUE)
p$plt
```

```{r}
data.frame(p$pca$x) %>%
   rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
   mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = "20260408_day 10_01_", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
   mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = ".RCC", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
   geom_point(size = 3) +
   theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
   ggtitle("D10 samples only, RUVg (2 components)") +
   scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
   ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = sample), size = 8)
```

### D14 - 1 component

With one component, the distributions are similar in the RLE plot.

PC1 (33% of variance), PC2 (20% of variance).


# Differential expression with limma


```{r eval=F}
# Extract expression data

expression_d10 <- data.frame(datRUVg_d10$exprs)
expression_d10 %<>% rownames_to_column("Accession") %>% 
  left_join(data.frame(datRUVg_d10$dict), by = "Accession") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CodeClass == "Endogenous")

expression_d14 <- data.frame(datRUVg_d14$exprs)
expression_d14 %<>% rownames_to_column("Accession") %>% 
  left_join(data.frame(datRUVg_d14$dict), by = "Accession") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CodeClass == "Endogenous")

# Normalize in the same way as above, output in expression set format
datRUVg_d10_exprSet <- processNanostringData(nsFiles = rcc_d10,
                             normalization = "RUVg",
                             bgType = "none", 
                             n.unwanted = 2, 
                             RUVg.drop = 0,
                             housekeeping = use_hkg_names)

datRUVg_d14_exprSet <- processNanostringData(nsFiles = rcc_d14,
                             normalization = "RUVg",
                             bgType = "none", 
                             n.unwanted = 1, 
                             RUVg.drop = 0,
                             housekeeping = use_hkg_names)
```

```{r}
# Helper function for gene of interest plots
goi_plots <- function(goi, stats_data, expr_data, day) {
    print(stats_data[goi,])

    print(
    expr_data %>% 
        filter(Name == goi) %>% 
        pivot_longer(contains("RCC")) %>% 
        mutate(sample_id_clean = janitor::make_clean_names(name)) %>% 
        mutate(day_color = ifelse(grepl("day.10", name), "D10", "D14")) %>%
        mutate(sample = gsub(name, pattern = "X20260408_day.10_01_", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
        mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = "X20260408_day.14_01_", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
        mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = ".RCC", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
        left_join(sample_info, by = "sample_id_clean") %>% 
            ggplot(aes(y = value, x = treatment)) + 
            geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5,) + 
            geom_point(aes(color = day_color)) + 
            theme_bw() +
            ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label=sample, color = day_color), size = 8)   +
            ggtitle(paste0(goi, " expression in Day ", day, " samples")) +
            labs(x = "Treatment", y = paste0(goi, " gene expression"))
    )
}
``` 

IO genes of interest (Il27 is not present in the panel)

```{r}
io_goi <- c("Csf1", "Il1a", "Il27", "Ccl3", "Vcam1", 
"Csf2", "Il1b", "Ccl9", "Il10", "Ifng", "Tnf", "Il2", 
"Ccl11", "Il18", "Ccl4", "Il6", "Cxcl1")
io_goi <- intersect(io_goi, gene_details$official_symbol)

my_goi <- c("Foxp3", "Ifng", "Tnf", "Ccl3", "Cd274", "Pdcd1", "Cd163", "Cd86", "Ms4a4a")
```

## Both days together?

```{r eval=F}
# Extract expression data

expression_bothdays <- data.frame(datRUVg_bothdays$exprs)
expression_bothdays %<>% rownames_to_column("Accession") %>% 
  left_join(data.frame(datRUVg_bothdays$dict), by = "Accession") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CodeClass == "Endogenous")

# Normalize in the same way as above, output in expression set format
datRUVg_bothdays_exprSet <- processNanostringData(nsFiles = c(rcc_d10, rcc_d14),
                             normalization = "RUVg",
                             bgType = "none", 
                             n.unwanted = 2, 
                             RUVg.drop = 0,
                             housekeeping = use_hkg_names)

group_bothdays <- factor(c(rep("Control", 5), rep("Treatment", 6),
                           rep("Control", 5), rep("Treatment", 4)), 
                    levels = c("Control", "Treatment"))
day_bothdays <- factor(c(rep("D10", 11), rep("D14", 9)), levels = c("D10", "D14"))

design <- model.matrix(~group_bothdays + day_bothdays)

de_results_bothdays <- runLimmaAnalysis(
    dat = datRUVg_bothdays_exprSet, 
    groups = group_bothdays, 
    base.group = "Control",
    codeclass.retain = "Endogenous",
    design = design
)
limmaStats_bothdays <- makeDiffExprFile(de_results_bothdays, filename = NULL, returns = "stats")
limmaStats_bothdays <- as.data.frame(limmaStats_bothdays)
```

```{r eval=F}
for (g in c("Cd8a")) {
    goi_plots(g, limmaStats_bothdays, expression_bothdays, day = "Both")
}
```

## D10

Nominal p-value used in volcano plot and DEG output table as no genes were significant by q-value.

```{r eval=F}
# Define the group variable
group_d10 <- factor(c(rep("Control", 5), rep("Treatment", 6)), 
                    levels = c("Control", "Treatment"))

# Perform differential expression analysis
de_results_d10 <- runLimmaAnalysis(
    dat = datRUVg_d10_exprSet, 
    groups = group_d10, 
    base.group = "Control",
    codeclass.retain = "Endogenous"
)
limmaStats_d10 <- makeDiffExprFile(de_results_d10, filename = NULL, returns = "stats")
limmaStats_d10 <- as.data.frame(limmaStats_d10)
```

```{r}
deVolcano(de_results_d10, y.var = "p.value") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.3, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred") + # 0.05 p-value threshold
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred") + # fold change of 2 (linear scale)
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred")
```

```{r}
DT::datatable(limmaStats_d10 %>%
  filter(abs(`Log2FC (Treatment)`) > 0.5,
         `p-val (Treatment)` < 0.05))
```

```{r}
for (g in my_goi) {
    goi_plots(g, limmaStats_d10, expression_d10, day = "10")
}
```

```{r}
subset_data <- expression_d10 %>% 
filter(Name %in% io_goi) %>%
column_to_rownames("Name") %>%
select(contains("X20260408"))

# Normalize with z-score on the rows
z_score_data <- data.frame(t(apply(subset_data, 1, function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))))

# Convert to a matrix for heatmap
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(z_score_data)


# Create the heatmap


# Melt the heatmap matrix for ggplot
heatmap_data <- melt(heatmap_matrix)
colnames(heatmap_data) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "Expression")

# Create the heatmap using ggplot
# Perform hierarchical clustering on rows
row_order <- hclust(dist(heatmap_matrix))$order
heatmap_data$Gene <- factor(heatmap_data$Gene, levels = rownames(heatmap_matrix)[row_order])

# Create the heatmap with clustered rows
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Gene, fill = Expression)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30)) +
    labs(x = "D10 Samples", y = "Cell Types", fill = "Z-Score")
``` 

```{r}
sig_genes <- rownames(limmaStats_d10 %>%
  filter(abs(`Log2FC (Treatment)`) > 0.5,
         `p-val (Treatment)` < 0.05) %>% arrange(`Log2FC (Treatment)`))
subset_data <- expression_d10 %>% 
filter(Name %in% sig_genes) %>%
column_to_rownames("Name") %>%
select(contains("X20260408"))

# Normalize with z-score on the rows

# Convert to a matrix for heatmap
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(z_score_data[match(sig_genes, rownames(z_score_data)), ])

# Create the heatmap

heatmap_data <- melt(heatmap_matrix)
colnames(heatmap_data) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "Expression")

# Create the heatmap using ggplot
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Gene, fill = Expression)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, ),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30)) +
    labs(x = "D10 Samples", y = "Cell Types", fill = "Z-Score")
```

```{r eval=F}
    gene.sets = c(cell_type_gene_sets, annotation_gene_sets))$Treatment
fgseaResults_d10_annot_only <- limmaToFGSEA(de_results_d10,
```

## Visualize

```{r eval=F}
# include cell types and other gene sets
fgsea_results_combined <- bind_rows(
    fgseaResults_d14 %>% mutate(day = "D14"),
    fgseaResults_d10 %>% mutate(day = "D10")
)

fgsea_results_combined %>%
    mutate(star = ifelse(padj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", ""))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = day, y = pathway, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = star), color = "black", size = 5) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Day", y = "Pathway or Cell Type", fill = "Normalized\nEnrichment\nScore\n(GSVA)") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{r}
fgsea_results_annot_only_combined <- bind_rows(
    fgseaResults_d14_annot_only %>% mutate(day = "D14"),
    fgseaResults_d10_annot_only %>% mutate(day = "D10")
)

fgsea_results_annot_only_combined %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("_", " ", pathway) %>% tools::toTitleCase()) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Nk Cell", "NK Cells", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("t Cell", "T Cell", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("t Cells", "T Cells", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Jak Stat", "JAK STAT", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Nf Kappa b", "NF Kappa B", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Wnt", "WNT", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Tgf", "TGF", pathway)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Pi3k Akt", "PI3K AKT ", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Mapk", "MAPK ", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(pathway = gsub("Dna", "DNA", pathway, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%


    mutate(day = gsub("D", "Day ", day, ignore.case = F)) %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%  
    mutate(avg_NES = mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(avg_NES) %>%
    mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = unique(pathway))) %>%
    mutate(star = ifelse(padj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", ""))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = day, y = pathway, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = star), color = "black", size = 10) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "goldenrod1", mid = "white", high = "#00A600", midpoint = 0) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Normalized\nEnrichment\nScore\n(GSVA)") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 1.06),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
          legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.label.x = element_text(size = 30)) 


```

# GSEA on specific signatures

## Gene sets

```{r}
# Ideas from Rohan - looking in the literature for more.
m1_genes <- c("Cd80", "Cd86", "Cd68", "Tlr4", "Tlr2", 
"Tnfrsf1b", "Cxcl9", "Cxcl10", "Cxcl11", "Tnf", "Il12b", 
"Il6", "Nos2")
m2_genes <- c("Cd163", "Mrc1", "Msr1", "Mertk", 
"Marco", "Serpina1", "Ms4a4a", "Arg1")

pro_cytokines <- c("Ccl1","Ccl3","Ccl4","Ccl20","Cxcl1",
"Cxcl2","Cxcl3","Cxcl5","Cxcl9","Cxcl10","Cxcl11","Cxcl16",
"Cxcr2","Cxcr3","Il1a","Il1b","Il12rb2","Il15","Il16","Il17a",
"Il18","Il18r1","Il2","Il23r",
"Il33","Csf2","Stat1","Nfkb1","Rela","Ikbkb","Chuk")

anti_cytokines <- c("Ccl2","Ccl5","Ccl7","Ccl8","Ccl22",
"Cxcl12","Cxcr4","Csf1","Csf1r","Il6","Stat3","Il10","Il4")

print("M1 genes to be used: ")
print(intersect(m1_genes, expression_d14$Name))

print("M2 genes to be used: ")
print(intersect(m2_genes, expression_d14$Name))

print("Missing from panel but was suggested:")
# "Il2b" is missing from M1
setdiff(m1_genes, expression_d14$Name)
# "Msr1"     "Mertk"    "Serpina1" are missing from M2
setdiff(m2_genes, expression_d14$Name)

print("Pro-inflammatory cytokine genes to be used: ")
print(intersect(pro_cytokines, expression_d14$Name))

print("Anti-inflammatory cytokine genes to be used: ") 
print(intersect(anti_cytokines, expression_d14$Name))

exhausted_cd8_genes <- c(cell_type_gene_sets[["exhausted_cd8"]], "Pdcd1", "Havcr2", "Entpd1")

print("Exhausted CD8 T cell genes to be used: ")
print(intersect(exhausted_cd8_genes, expression_d14$Name))


treg_genes <- c(
    "Foxp3", "Ikzf2", "Ikzf4", "Bach2", "Irf4", "Prdm1", "Il2ra", 
    "Ctla4", 
    "Tnfrsf18", "Tnfrsf4",
    "Tigit", "Lag3", 
    "Itga4", 
    "Entpd1", 
    "Il10", "Tnfrsf9", "Layn", "Cd80", "Icos", "Fzd2"
)

print("Treg genes to be used: ")
print(intersect(treg_genes, expression_d14$Name))

signature_genes <- list(
    "m1" = m1_genes, 
    "m2" = m2_genes,
    "exhausted_cd8" = exhausted_cd8_genes,
    "pro_cytokines" = pro_cytokines,
    "anti_cytokines" = anti_cytokines,
    "treg" = treg_genes
    )
    
```

```{r}
fgseaResults_sigs_d10 <- limmaToFGSEA(de_results_d10, 
    gene.sets = signature_genes)$Treatment
DT::datatable(fgseaResults_sigs_d10 %>% arrange(padj))

fgseaResults_sigs_d14 <- limmaToFGSEA(de_results_d14, 
    gene.sets = signature_genes)$Treatment
DT::datatable(fgseaResults_sigs_d14 %>% arrange(padj))

ssgseaParam_d14_sig <- ssgseaParam(
    de_results_d14$eset,
    signature_genes
)
ssgsea_scores_sig_d14 <- data.frame(exprs(gsva(
    ssgseaParam_d14_sig
))) %>% rownames_to_column("sig") %>% pivot_longer(contains("RCC")) %>% 
mutate(sample_id_clean = janitor::make_clean_names(name, allow_dupes=T)) %>% 
mutate(sample = gsub(name, pattern = "X20260408_day.14_01_", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = ".RCC", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
left_join(sample_info, by = "sample_id_clean")

ssgseaParam_d10_sig <- ssgseaParam(
    de_results_d10$eset,
    signature_genes
)
ssgsea_scores_sig_d10 <- data.frame(exprs(gsva(
    ssgseaParam_d10_sig
))) %>% rownames_to_column("sig") %>% pivot_longer(contains("RCC")) %>% 
mutate(sample_id_clean = janitor::make_clean_names(name, allow_dupes=T)) %>% 
mutate(sample = gsub(name, pattern = "X20260408_day.10_01_", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
mutate(sample = gsub(sample, pattern = ".RCC", replacement = "", fixed=T)) %>%
left_join(sample_info, by = "sample_id_clean")

ssgsea_scores_sig_bothdays <- bind_rows(
    ssgsea_scores_sig_d14 %>% mutate(dayname = "Day 14"),
    ssgsea_scores_sig_d10 %>% mutate(dayname = "Day 10")
)
```

## Visualize

### M1/M2

```{r}
ssgsea_scores_sig_bothdays %>%
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("PBS", "TAK-188"), labels = c("Veh", "2.5 mpk\nTAK-188"))) %>%
    mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("m1", "m2"), labels = c("M1", "M2"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = treatment, y = value, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5, fill = "white") + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, shape = 21, size = 4, aes(fill = treatment)) + theme_bw() +
facet_grid(rows = vars(sig), cols = vars(dayname), scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "", y = "ssGSEA Score for Macrophage Polarization Gene Sets", fill = "Treatment") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
          legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "orangered2")) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", 
    label = "p.signif", 
    size = 8,
    label.x.npc = "center")
```

```{r eval=F}
fgsea_results_combined_mac <- bind_rows(
    fgseaResults_mac_d14 %>% mutate(day = "D14"),
    fgseaResults_mac_d10 %>% mutate(day = "D10")
)
```

```{r eval=F}
fgsea_results_combined_mac %>%
    mutate(star = ifelse(padj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", ""))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = day, y = pathway, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = star), color = "white", size = 30) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Day", y = "Macrophage Polarization", fill = "Normalized\nEnrichment\nScore\n(GSVA)") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{r eval=F}
## Other M1/M2 gene sets from the literature

# 5 in common
print("Macrophage Down genes: ")

# 4 in common
```

# Export DEG for cytokine genes

```{r eval=F}
DE_cytokines <- limmaStats_d10 %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_name") %>%
    filter(gene_name %in% annotation_gene_sets$cytokine_and_chemokine_signaling) %>%
    arrange(`p-val (Treatment)`) %>% 
    select(gene_name, `D10 Log2FC` = `Log2FC (Treatment)`, 
    `D10 p-val` = `p-val (Treatment)`, 
    `D10 q-val` = `q-val (Treatment)`) %>% left_join(by = "gene_name",
    limmaStats_d14 %>%
        rownames_to_column("gene_name") %>%
        filter(gene_name %in% annotation_gene_sets$cytokine_and_chemokine_signaling) %>%
        arrange(`p-val (Treatment)`) %>% 
        select(gene_name, `D14 Log2FC` = `Log2FC (Treatment)`, 
        `D14 p-val` = `p-val (Treatment)`, 
        `D14 q-val` = `q-val (Treatment)`))

write.table(DE_cytokines, 
file = "/root/capsule/results/20260430_TAK188_MouseNanostring_cytokine_DE_days_separate.tsv", 
sep = "\t", row.names = F, quote = F)


DE_cytokines_bothdays <- limmaStats_bothdays %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_name") %>%
    filter(gene_name %in% annotation_gene_sets$cytokine_and_chemokine_signaling) %>%
    arrange(`p-val (group_bothdaysTreatment)`) %>% 
    dplyr::select(gene_name, `Log2FC` = `Log2FC (group_bothdaysTreatment)`, 
    `p-val` = `p-val (group_bothdaysTreatment)`, 
    `q-val` = `q-val (group_bothdaysTreatment)`)

write.table(DE_cytokines_bothdays, 
file = "/root/capsule/results/20260430_TAK188_MouseNanostring_cytokine_DE_days_together.tsv", 
sep = "\t", row.names = F, quote = F)
```
